analysis_set.span: Pre-planned analysis on ITT population age 65-80

follow_up.span: Table 3 Effects of 3 weeks treatment with prolonged release melatonin (PRM) and placebo on sleep diary-recorded sleep latency in the low excretors and the elderly patients.

entry_age.span: Men and women aged between 18 and 80 years suffering from primary insomnia according to the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual for Mental Disorders (DSM-IV) criteria with sleep latency longer than 20 min were included in the study.

notes: The served estimate is the prespecified age 65-80 ITT subgroup, described in the full text as a subgroup of the FAS (PRM 137; placebo 144), not a completers efficacy set. Its assessment is at 3 weeks, not the end of the extension. Entry criteria and exclusions in the full-text Study subjects section and registry eligibility keep the population within adults with primary insomnia; the older adult subgroup is also within the question. The packet contains no held_local/...html reference; the included PMC full text and registry provide the quoted evidence.
